_about: Compact reference of Malaysian DSKP (Dokumen Standard Kurikulum dan Pentaksiran) structure and sample content/learning standards. Used as grounding for the Analyst agent. This is a representative sample, not the full official curriculum.

scheme_of_work_sample.topic: Cell as a Unit of Life

topics.topic: Cell as a Unit of Life
learning_standards: 2.1.1 Justify that cell is a basic unit of life
2.1.2 Identify and draw the general structure of animal and plant cells
2.1.3 State the function of each cell structure
2.2.1 Sequence the levels of cell organisation
3.2.1 Describe the arrangement of particles in solids, liquids and gases

scheme_of_work_sample.topic: Squares, Square Roots, Cubes and Cube Roots

learning_standards: 1.1.1 Recognise positive and negative numbers based on real-life situations
1.2.1 Add and subtract integers using number lines or other appropriate methods

content_standards: 1.1 Listening (Understand meaning in a variety of familiar contexts)
learning_standards: 1.1.1 Understand the main idea in simple texts
2.1.1 Ask about and describe future plans or events
